ja.V1_A1: 最初に話すのは、結婚して妻の姓を名乗り、妻の実家で家族と暮らしている男性だ。
ja.V1_MIN: 最初に話すのは、婿養子になって妻の姓を名乗っている男性。妻の実家で、家族と暮らしている。
ja.V1_B1: 最初に話すのは、結婚を機に妻の姓になった男性。妻や妻の家族と、同じ家で暮らしている。
ja.V2_B1: 次は、結婚を控えた息子が、相手の姓を名乗ると決めたことを知らされた母親。
ja.V3_B1: 最後は、妻の姓になった身内がいる親世代の人。子どもの結婚は、これからのこととして考えている。

en.V1_A1: The first speaker is a man who took his wife’s last name when they married. He lives with his family in his wife’s family home.
en.V1_MIN: The first speaker is a man who has been adopted into his wife’s family and uses her last name. He lives with his family in his wife’s family home.
en.V1_B1: The first speaker is a man who took his wife’s last name when they married. He lives with his wife and her family in the same house.
en.V2_B1: The next speaker is a mother whose son is about to get married. She has been told that he has decided to take his partner’s last name.
en.V3_B1: The last speaker is a parent whose relative took his wife’s last name. They see their own child’s marriage as something that lies ahead.

en.V1_A1: The first speaker is a man who took his wife’s last name. He lives with his family at his wife’s parents’ home.
en.V1_MIN: The first speaker is a man adopted into his wife’s family. He took her last name and lives with his family at her parents’ home.
en.V1_B1: The first speaker is a man who took his wife’s last name. He shares a home with his wife and her family.
en.V2_B1: The next speaker is a mother whose son will marry soon. She learned he decided to take his partner’s last name.
en.V3_B1: The last speaker is a parent whose relative took his wife’s last name. Their own child’s marriage is still something for the future.
